prompt: Describe version control branching. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Do not use any punctuation marks. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Must be written as a single continuous line of text.
evaluation_criteria:
Punctuation Exclusion: 0-5 (Evaluates zero punctuation)
Single Line: 0-5 (Evaluates absence of newlines)
response_text: Version control branching creates separate lines of development from a shared main branch allowing teams to work on new features bug fixes or experiments without disrupting the stable codebase each branch represents an independent snapshot of the code that can be merged back later when ready branches help isolate changes enabling parallel development and easier conflict resolution by keeping the main branch stable while developers test and refine their work in isolated environments
